title: Check relationships across processing boundaries
summary: When work is split into bounded chunks, validate not only each chunk but also relationships that cross chunk boundaries.

conditions: An input must be divided into chunks or batches.
Memory or resource limits make a single-pass approach impractical.
Relationships or dependencies may span adjacent chunks.
problem_pattern.failure_mode: Each chunk can appear locally correct while a relationship crossing a chunk boundary is lost.

generalised_method.action: Identify the resource constraint and the boundaries introduced by partitioning.
Ask an independent reviewer to look specifically for dependencies that cross those boundaries.
Where cross-boundary dependencies are plausible, consider overlapping adjacent chunks rather than treating each chunk as isolated.
Reconcile the relationships between adjacent chunks and run tests that deliberately exercise boundary cases.
Keep the initial failure and the reason for changing the method in the evidence trail; do not rewrite the history as though the final method was the first proposal.
Treat independent validation as evidence for the tested conditions, not as proof of correctness for every input.

applicability: Batch processing under memory or resource constraints.
Pipelines that partition sequences, documents, streams, spatial regions, or other connected inputs.
Any process where locally valid pieces can fail when recombined.
limitations: Overlap is not automatically sufficient; the required overlap depends on the maximum relevant dependency span.
A reconciliation pass must be designed around the actual relationship being preserved.
No performance or cost advantage is established by this example.
This skill has not been validated against production data or outside the synthetic case.

checks: An initial bounded-chunk proposal was challenged for ignoring cross-boundary relationships.
A validation finding exposed a boundary defect in the initial prototype.
A revised proposal introduced overlap and boundary reconciliation.
An independent validation message recorded a pass for the stated synthetic boundary cases.
A human made the selection and completion decisions; agent contributions remained separately attributed.
not_established: General correctness across all input types.
A universal choice of overlap size.
Automatic permission to reuse this method in every project.

reuse_guidance: Offer this as a candidate practice when the target work has comparable partition boundaries and cross-boundary dependencies. Recheck applicability, dependency span, and validation coverage before adopting it.
